audience.tooMany: More than 5,000 students — send it class by class

notices.title: Notices & circulars
notices.subtitle: Write a notice, choose who it is for, publish it to the app — and send it by SMS, WhatsApp or email if you like.
notices.expiresHint: Off the app’s list after this day (optional)
notices.audienceLocked: Who it is for can’t change once published.
notices.filesAfterSave: Save the draft first, then attach the circular (PDF), photos or forms.
notices.readsHint: Families who opened it in the app / students it reached
notices.publishHint: It appears in the family app for everyone it is for, straight away.
notices.alsoSend: Also send it to each family by
notices.channelHint: Messages use the wording in Notification rules › Notice or circular, with a link to the app.
notices.withdrawHint: It disappears from the family app. Messages already sent can’t be called back.
notices.emptyHint: Holidays, events, exam dates, circulars — families see them in the app.

messages.title: Send messages
messages.subtitle: A one-off message to families by SMS, WhatsApp or email. Every send is listed with how many arrived.
messages.subject: Email subject
messages.placeholder: e.g. School stays closed tomorrow because of heavy rain.
messages.dltHint: SMS in India must match a DLT-registered template on your SMS account, or the operator drops it. WhatsApp and email have no such rule.
messages.confirmHint: Each family in the audience gets it by the ways you ticked. This can’t be undone.
messages.sent: Sent to {{count}} families: {{queued}} messages queued, {{skipped}} not sent (no number / consent).

chat.title: Parent–teacher chat
chat.subtitle: Families write to their child’s teachers from the app; answer them here.
chat.startHint: You can write to families of the classes you teach. They read it in the app and are told by WhatsApp (Notification rules › Teacher replied in chat).
chat.hideHint: The family and the teacher see “removed”. It stays in the record for the school.
chat.readOnly: Only the teacher in this conversation can reply.

log.title: Delivery log
log.subtitle: Every SMS, WhatsApp and email to families — what went, to whom, and whether it arrived.
